descriptionHtml:
The IEEE Power & Energy Society Student Branch Chapter of the University of the Pacific (UOP) made a significant impact at Open Day 2023, captivating a diverse audience that included the general public and school children. Their exhibition focused on home distribution boards and safety precautions, aiming to enlighten attendees on efficient electrical management and safety in residential settings.

For the general public, the chapter provided insights into the role of home distribution boards in optimizing energy usage and ensuring reliable power distribution. Practical demonstrations and informative displays highlighted key safety measures for everyday living, enhancing the community's understanding of electrical systems within their homes.

The engagement with school children was particularly notable, as the chapter crafted an interactive experience tailored to inspire curiosity in electrical engineering. Through hands-on activities and age-appropriate educational materials, young participants were introduced to fundamental concepts, fostering an early interest in STEM disciplines.

In summary, the IEEE Power & Energy Society Student Branch Chapter's participation in Open Day 2023 not only showcased expertise in electrical engineering but also demonstrated a commitment to community outreach and education. By reaching out to the general public and school children, they successfully disseminated valuable knowledge and inspired a diverse audience toward a safer and more energy-efficient future.
venue: Department of Electrical & Electronic Engineering , Faculty of Engineering, University of Peradeniya
